versos.hebraico: מַשָּׂ֤א דְבַר־יְהוָה֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ חַדְרָ֔ךְ וְדַמֶּ֖שֶׂק מְנֻחָת֑וֹ כִּ֤י לַֽיהוָה֙ עֵ֣ין אָדָ֔ם וְכֹ֖ל שִׁבְטֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

controles.web: An oracle.  Yahweh’s word is against the land of Hadrach, and will rest upon Damascus; for the eye of man and of all the tribes of Israel is toward Yahweh;
controles.kjv: The burden of the word of the Lord in the land of Hadrach, and Damascus shall be the rest thereof: when the eyes of man, as of all the tribes of Israel, shall be toward the Lord.
controles.livre: Revelação da palavra do SENHOR contra terra de Hadraque e de Damasco, seu repouso; porque os olhos da humanidade e de todas as tribos de Israel estão voltados ao SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: וְגַם־חֲמָ֖ת תִּגְבָּל־בָּ֑הּ צֹ֣ר וְצִיד֔וֹן כִּ֥י חָֽכְמָ֖ה מְאֹֽד׃

controles.web: and Hamath, also, which borders on it; Tyre and Sidon, because they are very wise.
controles.kjv: And Hamath also shall border thereby; Tyrus, and Zidon, though it be very wise.
controles.livre: E também contra Hamate que faz fronteira com ela; Tiro e Sidom, ainda que seja muito sábia.

versos.hebraico: וַתִּ֥בֶן צֹ֛ר מָצ֖וֹר לָ֑הּ וַתִּצְבָּר־כֶּ֨סֶף֙ כֶּֽעָפָ֔ר וְחָר֖וּץ כְּטִ֥יט חוּצֽוֹת׃

controles.web: Tyre built herself a stronghold, and heaped up silver like the dust, and fine gold like the mire of the streets.
controles.kjv: And Tyrus did build herself a strong hold, and heaped up silver as the dust, and fine gold as the mire of the streets.
controles.livre: Tiro edificou para si fortalezas, e amontoou prata como pó da terra, e ouro como lama das ruas.

versos.hebraico: הִנֵּ֤ה אֲדֹנָי֙ יֽוֹרִשֶׁ֔נָּה וְהִכָּ֥ה בַיָּ֖ם חֵילָ֑הּ וְהִ֖יא בָּאֵ֥שׁ תֵּאָכֵֽל׃

controles.web: Behold, the Lord will dispossess her, and he will strike her power in the sea; and she will be devoured with fire.
controles.kjv: Behold, the Lord will cast her out, and he will smite her power in the sea; and she shall be devoured with fire.
controles.livre: Eis que o Senhor a desapossará, e no mar ferirá sua fortaleza, e ela será consumida pelo fogo.

versos.hebraico: תֵּרֶ֨א אַשְׁקְל֜וֹן וְתִירָ֗א וְעַזָּה֙ וְתָחִ֣יל מְאֹ֔ד וְעֶקְר֖וֹן כִּֽי־הֹבִ֣ישׁ מֶבָּטָ֑הּ וְאָ֤בַד מֶ֨לֶךְ֙ מֵֽעַזָּ֔ה וְאַשְׁקְל֖וֹן לֹ֥א תֵשֵֽׁב׃

controles.web: Ashkelon will see it, and fear; Gaza also, and will writhe in agony; as will Ekron, for her expectation will be disappointed; and the king will perish from Gaza, and Ashkelon will not be inhabited.
controles.kjv: Ashkelon shall see it, and fear; Gaza also shall see it, and be very sorrowful, and Ekron; for her expectation shall be ashamed; and the king shall perish from Gaza, and Ashkelon shall not be inhabited.
controles.livre: Asquelom verá, e temerá; Gaza também, e terá grande dor; assim como Ecrom, pois aquilo em que confiavam se envergonhará; o rei de Gaza perecerá, e Asquelom não será habitada.

versos.hebraico: וְיָשַׁ֥ב מַמְזֵ֖ר בְּאַשְׁדּ֑וֹד וְהִכְרַתִּ֖י גְּא֥וֹן פְּלִשְׁתִּֽים׃

controles.web: Foreigners will dwell in Ashdod, and I will cut off the pride of the Philistines.
controles.kjv: And a bastard shall dwell in Ashdod, and I will cut off the pride of the Philistines.
controles.livre: E um povo misturado habitará em Asdode, e eu acabarei com a arrogância dos filisteus;

versos.hebraico: וַהֲסִרֹתִ֨י דָמָ֜יו מִפִּ֗יו וְשִׁקֻּצָיו֙ מִבֵּ֣ין שִׁנָּ֔יו וְנִשְׁאַ֥ר גַּם־ה֖וּא לֵֽאלֹהֵ֑ינוּ וְהָיָה֙ כְּאַלֻּ֣ף בִּֽיהוּדָ֔ה וְעֶקְר֖וֹן כִּיבוּסִֽי׃

controles.web: I will take away his blood out of his mouth, and his abominations from between his teeth; and he also will be a remnant for our God; and he will be as a chieftain in Judah, and Ekron as a Jebusite.
controles.kjv: And I will take away his blood out of his mouth, and his abominations from between his teeth: but he that remaineth, even he, shall be for our God, and he shall be as a governor in Judah, and Ekron as a Jebusite.
controles.livre: E tirarei seu sangue de sua boca, e suas abominações dentre seus dentes; porém os que restarem serão para nosso Deus, e serão como príncipes em Judá; e Ecrom será como o jebuseu.

versos.hebraico: וְחָנִ֨יתִי לְבֵיתִ֤י מִצָּבָה֙ מֵעֹבֵ֣ר וּמִשָּׁ֔ב וְלֹֽא־יַעֲבֹ֧ר עֲלֵיהֶ֛ם ע֖וֹד נֹגֵ֑שׂ כִּ֥י עַתָּ֖ה רָאִ֥יתִי בְעֵינָֽי׃ס

controles.web: I will encamp around my house against the army, that no one pass through or return; and no oppressor will pass through them any more: for now I have seen with my eyes.
controles.kjv: And I will encamp about mine house because of the army, because of him that passeth by, and because of him that returneth: and no oppressor shall pass through them any more: for now have I seen with mine eyes.
controles.livre: E me acamparei ao redor de minha casa contra o exército inimigo ,para que não passe nem volte; para que o opressor não passe mais por eles; porque agora eu vi com meus olhos.

versos.hebraico: גִּילִ֨י מְאֹ֜ד בַּת־צִיּ֗וֹן הָרִ֨יעִי֙ בַּ֣ת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֔ם הִנֵּ֤ה מַלְכֵּךְ֙ יָ֣בוֹא לָ֔ךְ צַדִּ֥יק וְנוֹשָׁ֖ע ה֑וּא עָנִי֙ וְרֹכֵ֣ב עַל־חֲמ֔וֹר וְעַל־עַ֖יִר בֶּן־אֲתֹנֽוֹת׃

controles.web: Rejoice greatly, daughter of Zion! Shout, daughter of Jerusalem! Behold, your King comes to you! He is righteous, and having salvation; lowly, and riding on a donkey, even on a colt, the foal of a donkey.
controles.kjv: Rejoice greatly, O daughter of Zion; shout, O daughter of Jerusalem: behold, thy King cometh unto thee: he is just, and having salvation; lowly, and riding upon an ass, and upon a colt the foal of an ass.
controles.livre: Alegra-te muito, ó filha de Sião; dá vozes de júbilo, ó filha de Jerusalém; eis que teu rei virá a ti, justo e salvador, humilde, e montado sobre um asno, sobre um jumentinho, filho de jumenta.

versos.hebraico: וְהִכְרַתִּי־רֶ֣כֶב מֵאֶפְרַ֗יִם וְסוּס֙ מִיר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם וְנִכְרְתָה֙ קֶ֣שֶׁת מִלְחָמָ֔ה וְדִבֶּ֥ר שָׁל֖וֹם לַגּוֹיִ֑ם וּמָשְׁלוֹ֙ מִיָּ֣ם עַד־יָ֔ם וּמִנָּהָ֖ר עַד־אַפְסֵי־אָֽרֶץ׃

controles.web: I will cut off the chariot from Ephraim, and the horse from Jerusalem; and the battle bow will be cut off; and he will speak peace to the nations: and his dominion will be from sea to sea, and from the River to the ends of the earth.
controles.kjv: And I will cut off the chariot from Ephraim, and the horse from Jerusalem, and the battle bow shall be cut off: and he shall speak peace unto the heathen: and his dominion shall be from sea even to sea, and from the river even to the ends of the earth.
controles.livre: E destruirei as carruagens de Efraim, e os cavalos de Jerusalém; os arcos de guerra também serão quebrados; e ele falará paz às nações; e seu domínio será de mar a mar, e desde o rio até os confins da terra.

versos.hebraico: גַּם־אַ֣תְּ בְּדַם־בְּרִיתֵ֗ךְ שִׁלַּ֤חְתִּי אֲסִירַ֨יִךְ֙ מִבּ֔וֹר אֵ֥ין מַ֖יִם בּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: As for you also, because of the blood of your covenant, I have set free your prisoners from the pit in which is no water.
controles.kjv: As for thee also, by the blood of thy covenant I have sent forth thy prisoners out of the pit wherein is no water.
controles.livre: Quanto a ti, pelo sangue de teu pacto, eu libertei teus prisioneiros da cova em que não havia água.

versos.hebraico: שׁ֚וּבוּ לְבִצָּר֔וֹן אֲסִירֵ֖י הַתִּקְוָ֑ה גַּם־הַיּ֕וֹם מַגִּ֥יד מִשְׁנֶ֖ה אָשִׁ֥יב לָֽךְ׃

controles.web: Turn to the stronghold, you prisoners of hope! Even today I declare that I will restore double to you.
controles.kjv: Turn you to the strong hold, ye prisoners of hope: even to day do I declare that I will render double unto thee;
controles.livre: Voltai-vos à fortaleza, ó prisioneiros que tendes esperança; hoje também vos anuncio que vos recompensarei em dobro.

versos.hebraico: כִּֽי־דָרַ֨כְתִּי לִ֜י יְהוּדָ֗ה קֶ֚שֶׁת מִלֵּ֣אתִי אֶפְרַ֔יִם וְעוֹרַרְתִּ֤י בָנַ֨יִךְ֙ צִיּ֔וֹן עַל־בָּנַ֖יִךְ יָוָ֑ן וְשַׂמְתִּ֖יךְ כְּחֶ֥רֶב גִּבּֽוֹר׃

controles.web: For indeed I bend Judah as a bow for me. I have filled the bow with Ephraim; and I will stir up your sons, Zion, against your sons, Greece, and will make you like the sword of a mighty man.
controles.kjv: When I have bent Judah for me, filled the bow with Ephraim, and raised up thy sons, O Zion, against thy sons, O Greece, and made thee as the sword of a mighty man.
controles.livre: Pois encurvarei a Judá para mim como arco, porei a Efraim como flecha;  e despertarei teus filhos, ó Sião, contra teus filhos, ó Grécia; e farei de ti, Sião , como espada de guerreiro.

versos.hebraico: וַֽיהוָה֙ עֲלֵיהֶ֣ם יֵֽרָאֶ֔ה וְיָצָ֥א כַבָּרָ֖ק חִצּ֑וֹ וַֽאדֹנָ֤י יְהֹוִה֙ בַּשּׁוֹפָ֣ר יִתְקָ֔ע וְהָלַ֖ךְ בְּסַעֲר֥וֹת תֵּימָֽן׃

controles.web: Yahweh will be seen over them; and his arrow will go flash like lightning; and the Lord Yahweh will blow the trumpet, and will go with whirlwinds of the south.
controles.kjv: And the Lord shall be seen over them, and his arrow shall go forth as the lightning: and the Lord God shall blow the trumpet, and shall go with whirlwinds of the south.
controles.livre: E o SENHOR será visto acima deles, e sua flecha sairá como relâmpago; o Senhor DEUS tocará trombeta, e irá como os turbilhões do sul.

versos.hebraico: יְהוָ֣ה צְבָאוֹת֮ יָגֵ֣ן עֲלֵיהֶם֒ וְאָכְל֗וּ וְכָֽבְשׁוּ֙ אַבְנֵי־קֶ֔לַע וְשָׁת֥וּ הָמ֖וּ כְּמוֹ־יָ֑יִן וּמָֽלְאוּ֙ כַּמִּזְרָ֔ק כְּזָוִיּ֖וֹת מִזְבֵּֽחַ׃

controles.web: Yahweh of Armies will defend them; and they will destroy and overcome with sling stones; and they will drink, and roar as through wine; and they will be filled like bowls, like the corners of the altar.
controles.kjv: The Lord of hosts shall defend them; and they shall devour, and subdue with sling stones; and they shall drink, and make a noise as through wine; and they shall be filled like bowls, and as the corners of the altar.
controles.livre: O SENHOR dos exércitos os protegerá, e eles consumirão, e sujeitarão com pedras da funda; também beberão e farão gritarias como bêbados de vinho; e se encherão como a bacia de sacrifício, ou como os cantos do altar.

versos.hebraico: וְֽהוֹשִׁיעָ֞ם יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֛ם בַּיּ֥וֹם הַה֖וּא כְּצֹ֣אן עַמּ֑וֹ כִּ֚י אַבְנֵי־נֵ֔זֶר מִֽתְנוֹסְס֖וֹת עַל־אַדְמָתֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Yahweh their God will save them in that day as the flock of his people; for they are like the jewels of a crown, lifted on high over his land.
controles.kjv: And the Lord their God shall save them in that day as the flock of his people: for they shall be as the stones of a crown, lifted up as an ensign upon his land.
controles.livre: E o SENHOR, Deus deles, os salvará naquele dia como o rebanho de seu povo; porque serão como pedras de coroa, erguidas na terra dele.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֥י מַה־טּוּב֖וֹ וּמַה־יָפְי֑וֹ דָּגָן֙ בַּֽחוּרִ֔ים וְתִיר֖וֹשׁ יְנוֹבֵ֥ב בְּתֻלֽוֹת׃

controles.web: For how great is his goodness, and how great is his beauty! Grain will make the young men flourish, and new wine the virgins.
controles.kjv: For how great is his goodness, and how great is his beauty! corn shall make the young men cheerful, and new wine the maids.
controles.livre: Pois como será grande sua prosperidade, e tamanha sua beleza! O trigo fortalecerá  os rapazes, e o suco de uva as virgens.
